“Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?
Is it possible for Leviathan to be pulled out with a fish-hook, or for a hook to be put through the bone of his mouth?
你能用魚鉤釣上鱷魚嗎？能用繩子壓下牠的舌頭嗎？
Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?
Will you put a cord into his nose, or take him away with a cord round his tongue?
你能用繩索穿牠的鼻子嗎？能用鉤穿牠的腮骨嗎？
Will he beg you for mercy or speak to you softly?
Will he make prayers to you, or say soft words to you?
牠豈向你連連懇求，說柔和的話嗎？
Will he make a covenant with you to take him as a slave for life?
Will he make an agreement with you, so that you may take him as a servant for ever?
豈肯與你立約，使你拿牠永遠作奴僕嗎？
Can you pet him like a bird or put him on a leash for your maidens?
Will you make sport with him, as with a bird? or put him in chains for your young women?
你豈可拿牠當雀鳥玩耍嗎？豈可為你的幼女將牠拴住嗎？
Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants?
Will the fishermen make profit out of him? will they have him cut up for the traders?
搭夥的漁夫豈可拿牠當貨物嗎？能把牠分給商人嗎？
Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?
Will you put sharp-pointed irons into his skin, or fish-spears into his head?
你能用倒鉤槍扎滿牠的皮，能用魚叉叉滿牠的頭嗎？
If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the battle and never repeat it!
Only put your hand on him, and see what a fight you will have; you will not do it again!
你按手在牠身上，想與牠爭戰，就不再這樣行吧！
Surely hope of overcoming him is false. Is not the sight of him overwhelming?
Truly, the hope of his attacker is false; he is overcome even on seeing him!
人指望捉拿牠是徒然的；一見牠，豈不喪膽嗎？
No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan. Then who is able to stand against Me?
He is so cruel that no one is ready to go against him. Who then is able to keep his place before me?
沒有那麼兇猛的人敢惹牠。這樣，誰能在我面前站立得住呢？
Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
Who ever went against me, and got the better of me? There is no one under heaven!
誰先給我甚麼，使我償還呢？天下萬物都是我的。
I cannot keep silent about his limbs, his power and graceful form.
I will not keep quiet about the parts of his body, or about his power, and the strength of his frame.
論到鱷魚的肢體和其大力，並美好的骨骼，我不能緘默不言。
Who can strip off his outer coat? Who can approach him with a bridle?
Who has ever taken off his outer skin? who may come inside his inner coat of iron?
誰能剝牠的外衣？誰能進牠上下牙骨之間呢？
Who can open his jaws, ringed by his fearsome teeth?
Who has made open the doors of his face? Fear is round about his teeth.
誰能開牠的腮頰？牠牙齒四圍是可畏的。
His rows of scales are his pride, tightly sealed together.
His back is made of lines of plates, joined tight together, one against the other, like a stamp.
牠以堅固的鱗甲為可誇，緊緊合閉，封得嚴密。
One scale is so near to another that no air can pass between them.
One is so near to the other that no air may come between them.
這鱗甲一一相連，甚至氣不得透入其間，
They are joined to one another; they clasp and cannot be separated.
They take a grip of one another; they are joined together, so that they may not be parted.
都是互相聯絡、膠結，不能分離。
His snorting flashes with light, and his eyes are like the rays of dawn.
His sneezings give out flames, and his eyes are like the eyes of the dawn.
牠打噴嚏就發出光來；牠眼睛好像早晨的光線（原文是眼皮）。
Firebrands stream from his mouth; fiery sparks shoot forth!
Out of his mouth go burning lights, and flames of fire are jumping up.
從牠口中發出燒著的火把，與飛迸的火星；
Smoke billows from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
Smoke comes out of his nose, like a pot boiling on the fire.
從牠鼻孔冒出煙來，如燒開的鍋和點著的蘆葦。
His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames pour from his mouth.
His breath puts fire to coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.
牠的氣點著煤炭，有火焰從牠口中發出。
Strength resides in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
Strength is in his neck, and fear goes dancing before him.
牠頸項中存著勁力；在牠面前的都恐嚇蹦跳。
The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
The plates of his flesh are joined together, fixed, and not to be moved.
牠的肉塊互相聯絡，緊貼其身，不能搖動。
His chest is as hard as a rock, as hard as a lower millstone!
His heart is as strong as a stone, hard as the lower crushing-stone.
牠的心結實如石頭，如下磨石那樣結實。
When Leviathan rises up, the mighty are terrified; they withdraw before his thrashing.
When he gets ready for the fight, the strong are overcome with fear.
牠一起來，勇士都驚恐，心裡慌亂，便都昏迷。
The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or dart or arrow.
The sword may come near him but is not able to go through him; the spear, or the arrow, or the sharp-pointed iron.
人若用刀，用槍，用標槍，用尖槍扎牠，都是無用。
He regards iron as straw and bronze as rotten wood.
Iron is to him as dry grass, and brass as soft wood.
牠以鐵為乾草，以銅為爛木。
No arrow can make him flee; slingstones become like chaff to him.
The arrow is not able to put him to flight: stones are no more to him than dry stems.
箭不能恐嚇牠使牠逃避；彈石在牠看為碎秸。
A club is regarded as straw, and he laughs at the sound of the lance.
A thick stick is no better than a leaf of grass, and he makes sport of the onrush of the spear.
棍棒算為禾秸；牠嗤笑短槍颼的響聲。
His undersides are jagged potsherds, spreading out the mud like a threshing sledge.
Under him are sharp edges of broken pots: as if he was pulling a grain-crushing instrument over the wet earth.
牠肚腹下如尖瓦片；牠如釘耙經過淤泥。
He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
The deep is boiling like a pot of spices, and the sea like a perfume-vessel.
牠使深淵開滾如鍋，使洋海如鍋中的膏油。
He leaves a glistening wake behind him; one would think the deep had white hair!
After him his way is shining, so that the deep seems white.
牠行的路隨後發光，令人想深淵如同白髮。
Nothing on earth is his equal— a creature devoid of fear!
On earth there is not another like him, who is made without fear.
在地上沒有像牠造的那樣，無所懼怕。
He looks down on all the haughty; he is king over all the proud.”
Everything which is high goes in fear of him; he is king over all the sons of pride.
凡高大的，牠無不藐視；牠在驕傲的水族上作王。
